During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] went on a '''mission''' to a [[Unidentified besieged moon|moon]] besieged by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in order to evacuate the last of its population.
